rationale: Pulp plugin hosts route a native press through both native ComboBox dismissal and the @pulp/react active-overlay bridge. This Pulp-only follow-up makes an outside press consumed when either bridge dismisses its popup, preventing that same host event from muting or drawing a Spectr band underneath the closed overlay. It extends the Pulp-specific plugin-host reconciliation recorded by 20260817-plugin-host-overlay-dismissal; a Vellum-native retained UI should define its own single popup input contract rather than copy the dual bridge.
